features.title: Designed around you. Flow work desks offer uncluttered surfaces and smart functionality, helping you focus and perform better in any office by offering functional strength for evolving work environments.
Designed to balance form and function, Flow desks pair clean, minimal lines with clutter-free surfaces for a workspace that feels calm and focused.
Stay comfortable longer. With generous leg space and optimal surface height, Flow desks make good posture and focus feel natural.
Durability meets design. Flow desks combine a sturdy base with a scratch-resistant worktop, keeping your workspace stylish and strong.
Stay productive as you scale. Flow desks expand with modular layouts that support individuals, small teams, or entire departments.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
